The held awake gas-exchange exception/ranked arterial-gas investigation is the keyed decision. Existing screening and reduced-bicarbonate metabolic-acidosis claims do not establish this raised-total-CO2 comparison. Removing a medicine-list detail would not resolve the hold. No adequate direct check was recorded and network is prohibited.
